BTCUSD // 5M SIGNAL · 1M EXECUTION BACKTESTER

DATA SOURCE: DELTA EXCHANGE API

01  //  Configuration

Live-aligned research mode: signal conditions, pending-entry lifecycle and daily-loss behavior are aligned to the live bot rules. Strategy signals remain on the selected timeframe. 1-minute candles are used only to resolve execution inside the entry candle; actual live market orders can still fill differently because of slippage/latency.

Idle — configure and run.

Fetches candles in 2,000-bar chunks (Delta Exchange's per-request cap) from api.india.delta.exchange, falling back to api.delta.exchange if the first is unreachable. The selected resolution is used automatically for pagination, so you can test the same strategy on different timeframes. If every request fails, your browser is likely blocking the request via CORS; try a different network, a CORS-friendly proxy, or run this file through a local dev server instead of opening it directly as a file.

Charges: broker charge is applied on both the entry and exit leg of every trade; GST is then applied on top of that broker charge (as per India's tax treatment of brokerage). All return/drawdown/equity figures below are net of both.

Daily loss limit: after a losing trade, the next trade is still allowed. If that next trade also loses (i.e. consecutive losses reach the threshold set above), no further trades are taken for the rest of that calendar day. A winning trade resets the consecutive-loss count back to zero, and the count also resets automatically at the start of each new day.

Fee guardrails: trades are skipped if the signal-candle stop is tighter than the minimum stop percentage, if the risk-based position would require more than the maximum effective leverage, or if estimated entry+exit broker charges plus GST would exceed the configured percentage of the planned 1R risk amount.

Important: the Results panel now records the exact RR, risk %, fee, GST, minimum stop, leverage cap and maximum fee/risk settings used in that backtest so different runs cannot be confused.

Intrabar execution: BUY-B uses low <= EMA and SELL-B uses high >= EMA; T0 cannot self-trigger. When a later strategy candle breaks the trigger, its 1-minute candles are processed chronologically. The first 1m candle that breaks the trigger creates the entry at the trigger price. SL/TP are deliberately ignored on that same 1m entry candle; protection starts from the next 1m candle, including later 1m candles inside the same strategy candle. For later strategy candles, 1m candles resolve SL-vs-TP when both levels are reachable; if both occur inside the same 1m candle, SL wins.

02  //  Parameter Optimizer

The optimizer fetches the selected market data once, then runs the same backtest repeatedly over different parameter combinations. Fixed values from Configuration — symbol, resolution, dates, starting capital, broker fee and GST — are reused. To avoid a meaningless result caused only by taking more risk, Risk per Trade is fixed at the Configuration value.
